rules.name: migration-checks-02-detail-dev-uat
rules.sql: SELECT v.business_unit, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.valuation_date_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS valuation_rows, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.security_info_table s WHERE s.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS has_security_info, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.client_master_data m WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant AND m.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS has_clients, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.latest_active_lot l WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS has_active_lots, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS has_deal_lots FROM (SELECT DISTINCT business_unit FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit IS NOT NULL) v ORDER BY v.business_unit

SELECT v.business_unit, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.valuation_date_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS valuation_rows, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.security_info_table s WHERE s.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS has_security_info, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.client_master_data m WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant AND m.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS has_clients, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.latest_active_lot l WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS has_active_lots, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS has_deal_lots FROM (SELECT DISTINCT business_unit FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit IS NOT NULL) v ORDER BY v.business_unit

SELECT tablename, status_type, status, count(*) AS rows_without_bu, min(valuation_date) AS first_value_date, max(valuation_date) AS last_value_date FROM opera.status_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit IS NULL GROUP BY tablename, status_type, status ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT tablename, status_type, status, count(*) AS rows_without_bu, min(valuation_date) AS first_value_date, max(valuation_date) AS last_value_date FROM opera.status_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit IS NULL GROUP BY tablename, status_type, status ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE price AS ( SELECT (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant) AS underlying_id UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.underlying_id > price.underlying_id) FROM price WHERE price.underlying_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT 'currency_spot_mapping_table.spot' AS source, m.spot AS stored_value, p.underlying_id AS price_table_spelling, count(*) AS rows FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN price p ON lower(p.underlying_id) = lower(m.spot) AND p.underlying_id <> m.spot WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY m.spot, p.underlying_id UNION ALL SELECT 'product_master_table.curr_mult_factor', m.curr_mult_factor, p.underlying_id, count(*) FROM opera.product_master_table m JOIN price p ON lower(p.underlying_id) = lower(m.curr_mult_factor) AND p.underlying_id <> m.curr_mult_factor WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY m.curr_mult_factor, p.underlying_id ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH RECURSIVE price AS ( SELECT (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant) AS underlying_id UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.underlying_id > price.underlying_id) FROM price WHERE price.underlying_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT 'currency_spot_mapping_table.spot' AS source, m.spot AS stored_value, p.underlying_id AS price_table_spelling, count(*) AS rows FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN price p ON lower(p.underlying_id) = lower(m.spot) AND p.underlying_id <> m.spot WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY m.spot, p.underlying_id UNION ALL SELECT 'product_master_table.curr_mult_factor', m.curr_mult_factor, p.underlying_id, count(*) FROM opera.product_master_table m JOIN price p ON lower(p.underlying_id) = lower(m.curr_mult_factor) AND p.underlying_id <> m.curr_mult_factor WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY m.curr_mult_factor, p.underlying_id ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT underlying_id, count(*) AS price_rows, max(value_date) AS last_value_date FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(underlying_id) IN ( SELECT lower(spot) FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant UNION SELECT lower(curr_mult_factor) FROM opera.product_master_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant) GROUP BY underlying_id HAVING lower(underlying_id) IN ( SELECT lower(underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY lower(underlying_id) HAVING count(DISTINCT underlying_id) > 1) ORDER BY lower(underlying_id), underlying_id

SELECT underlying_id, count(*) AS price_rows, max(value_date) AS last_value_date FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(underlying_id) IN ( SELECT lower(spot) FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant UNION SELECT lower(curr_mult_factor) FROM opera.product_master_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant) GROUP BY underlying_id HAVING lower(underlying_id) IN ( SELECT lower(underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY lower(underlying_id) HAVING count(DISTINCT underlying_id) > 1) ORDER BY lower(underlying_id), underlying_id
